title: Learning Continuous Regional Temperature Fields with Lead-Time and Resolution Queries
abstract: arXiv:2608.25823v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate regional near-surface temperature forecasting is fundamental to short-range weather services and downstream risk assessment. Existing deep learning-based regional forecasters commonly produce a fixed set of future frames on a prescribed grid, limiting their use when forecast products must be evaluated at query-dependent lead times or display resolutions. To overcome these fixed-output constraints, we formulate regional T2M forecasting as query-conditioned continuous spatiotemporal temperature field evaluation and propose the Continuous Spatiotemporal Temperature Forecaster (CSTF), a neural field that turns forecast lead time and output resolution into explicit queries when evaluating 2-m temperature (T2M). Specifically, CSTF first encodes multivariable ERA5 histories into latent meteorological states and then decodes T2M as a coordinate-based field. translated_title: 基于提前期和分辨率查询的学习连续区域温度场
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.25823v1 公告类型：新 摘要：准确的区域近地表温度预报对于短期天气服务和下游风险评估至关重要。现有的基于深度学习的区域预报器通常在预定网格上生成固定的一组未来帧，这限制了它们在预报产品必须根据查询相关的提前期或显示分辨率进行评估时的使用。为克服这些固定输出限制，我们将区域T2M预报建模为查询条件的连续时空温度场评估，并提出连续时空温度预报器（CSTF），这是一个神经场，在评估2米温度（T2M）时将预报提前期和输出分辨率转化为显式查询。具体来说，CSTF首先将多变量ERA5历史数据编码为潜在气象状态，然后解码T2M作为基于坐标的场。因此，空间位置、预报提前期和输出分辨率被整合进模型。
tldr: 该论文提出一种连续时空温度预报器（CSTF），通过神经场将预报提前期和分辨率作为查询条件，实现灵活的区域温度预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Continuous Spatiotemporal Temperature Forecaster (CSTF) that uses a neural field to treat forecast lead time and resolution as queries, enabling flexible regional temperature prediction.
